name: final-grade
title: Final grade out of 20
prompt:
`final_grade(marks, weights)` in `grades.py` computes a student's weighted grade out of 20. Make it:
- round the result to the nearest 0.25, halves rounding up (12.125 → 12.25, 12.12 → 12.0)
- treat `None` marks as absences counted as 0
- raise `ValueError` if the lists have different lengths, if any weight is negative, if all
  weights are 0, or if any mark is outside 0..20
